abstract_sentences.text: Dataset bias often leads deep learning models to exploit spurious correlations instead of task-relevant signals.
We introduce the Standard Anti-Causal Model (SAM), a unifying causal framework that characterizes bias mechanisms and yields a conditional independence criterion for causal stability.
Building on this theory, we propose DISCO_m and sDISCO, efficient and scalable estimators of conditional distance correlation that enable independence regularization in gradient-based models.

Across six diverse datasets, our methods consistently outperform or are competitive in existing observed bias mitigation approaches, while requiring fewer hyperparameters and scaling seamlessly to multi-bias scenarios.
This work bridges causal theory and practical deep learning, providing both a principled foundation and effective tools for robust prediction.

claim_closure.claim: Y-hat independent of B given Y is sufficient for causal stability under SAM.
claim_closure.method_response: SAM partitions B=W union Z and Definition 2.2 states desired zero indirect/spurious effects.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorem 2.3 in main text and Appendix E.2 proof; controlled dSprites path analysis is a compatible diagnostic.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5 restates the conditional independence criterion as guaranteeing causal stability.

claim_closure.claim: An MLE predictor satisfying the criterion maximizes the counterfactually stable effect.
claim_closure.method_response: Theorem 2.4 and Eq. (6) formulate the constrained objective.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Appendix E proves the causal-independence statements, while finite-batch Eq. (19) uses a regularizer rather than the exact constraint.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5 says predictions rely on stable direct effects but does not add a finite-sample optimization proof.

claim_closure.claim: DISCO_m consistently estimates conditional distance correlation.
claim_closure.method_response: DISCO_m samples local reference points in Eq. (15).
claim_closure.evidence_response: Proposition 3.5 points to Appendix F.3, which states kernel bandwidth and asymptotic conditions then proves convergence in probability.

claim_closure.claim: sDISCO exactly evaluates the global sample conditional distance correlation using O(n²) memory.
claim_closure.method_response: Eq. (16)–(18) and Proposition 3.6 specify the factorized computation.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Appendix G derives Eq. (40)–(51); Table 7 supplies one FairFace GPU benchmark with large-batch OOM comparisons.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5 calls sDISCO a single-shot efficient alternative.

claim_closure.claim: DISCO variants consistently outperform or are competitive across six datasets.
claim_closure.method_response: Eq. (19) gives the evaluated regularized objective.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 2 covers six named tasks and gives mean ± SD, but no run count; CIRCE has the highest Waterbirds value.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5 repeats the claim as outperform or competitive.

claim_closure.claim: Observed multi-bias conditioning supports causal path analysis and clarifies residual unknown-bias effects.
claim_closure.method_response: SAM defines observed B and §2.2 delimits unobserved Z-prime.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 3 is a fully controlled dSprites comparison, with no external deployment test of unobserved confounding.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §5 says SAM enables pathway-specific counterfactual analysis.

final_judgment.single_storyline: SAM 把 observed bias 的路径问题化为 Y-hat independent of B given Y，再用 DISCO estimators 近似这一 training-time conditional-independence regularizer；sDISCO 的 factorization 解决 full-batch memory bottleneck。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 bias 图、SAM/criterion、Eq. (13)–(19)、六数据集 Table 2、受控 path analysis、结论与限制；这些足以判断主张范围和主性能。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录迁移 proofs、exact factorization derivation、旧实现纠错、dataset generators、baseline adaptation、grids、counterfactual examples/diagnostics 与 runtime conditions；主张的 proof/reproducibility 审查依赖这些页。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效的结构是 causal graph → observable criterion → differentiable estimator → controlled counterfactual diagnostic → heterogeneous-task main table，理论与实证共用同一个 B/Y-hat pathway。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 六数据集主表有均值±标准差但未给 seed/run count、training budget 和全体 hardware；component ablation 缺失；finite-sample penalty 到 causal stability 的端到端保证未与 SAM theorem 同层级给出；Waterbirds 的最佳表项是 CIRCE。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 把因果假设写进训练目标时，应逐段对齐图假设、可观察 criterion、可计算惩罚、受控机制检验与任务级结果，并让每段的前提和未覆盖范围可见。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则需要可信的 observed bias labels、overlap、适当的 causal graph 与估计条件；它不能单独识别零 overlap、未知混杂、语义不稳标签或无监督 deployment。
